mechanism: Both drugs can cause metabolic acidosis and may increase risk of renal complications; dorzolamide inhibits carbonic anhydrase leading to systemic effects including acidosis, while sulfasalazine can affect renal function and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and acid-base status periodically during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative topical carbonic anhydrase inhibitors if systemic effects emerge.
